2027.summary: Formula 1 has published a 24-race calendar for 2027. The season opens in Bahrain on 12–14 March and ends in Abu Dhabi on 10–12 December.
changes: Portugal returns at Portimão (18–20 June) and Türkiye returns at Istanbul Park (1–3 October).
Bahrain goes back to Sakhir after its one-off 2026 race at Sepang, and Saudi Arabia is back in Jeddah (19–21 March).
Ten Sprint weekends, up from six: Bahrain, Australia, Japan, Canada, Monaco (its first Sprint), Britain, Italy, São Paulo, Qatar and Abu Dhabi.
Spain's only round is Madrid (10–12 September); Portimão takes the slot Barcelona held.
2027.status: Dates are confirmed. Session times are published closer to each weekend, so every race shows TBC until then.
2027.summary_fr: La Formule 1 a publié un calendrier de 24 Grands Prix pour 2027. La saison s'ouvre à Bahreïn du 12 au 14 mars et se termine à Abou Dhabi du 10 au 12 décembre.
changes_fr: Retour du Portugal à Portimão (18–20 juin) et de la Turquie à Istanbul Park (1er–3 octobre).
Bahreïn retrouve Sakhir après sa course exceptionnelle de 2026 à Sepang, et l'Arabie saoudite revient à Djeddah (19–21 mars).
Dix week-ends Sprint au lieu de six : Bahreïn, Australie, Japon, Canada, Monaco (son premier Sprint), Grande-Bretagne, Italie, São Paulo, Qatar et Abou Dhabi.
L'Espagne n'a plus qu'une manche, à Madrid (10–12 septembre) ; Portimão reprend la place de Barcelone.
2027.status_fr: Les dates sont confirmées. Les horaires des séances sont publiés à l'approche de chaque week-end : ils s'affichent « à confirmer » d'ici là.

2027.summary: MotoGP's provisional 2027 calendar has 22 rounds and opens the new 850cc era. It starts in Thailand on 5–7 March and finishes in Valencia on 26–28 November.
changes: Two new venues: Buenos Aires (Autódromo Oscar y Juan Gálvez, 9–11 April) and the Adelaide street circuit (12–14 November), which takes over the Australian Grand Prix from Phillip Island.
Balaton Park (Hungary) is not on the 2027 calendar.
Qatar moves back to the start of the season (12–14 March) after its 2026 round was pushed to November.
Portimão moves to early October (1–3 October), between Aragon and the Asian flyaways.
2027.status: The calendar is provisional and subject to FIM approval. Session times are TBC.
2027.summary_fr: Le calendrier provisoire MotoGP 2027 compte 22 manches et ouvre l'ère des 850 cm³. Il débute en Thaïlande du 5 au 7 mars et s'achève à Valence du 26 au 28 novembre.
changes_fr: Deux nouveaux circuits : Buenos Aires (Autódromo Oscar y Juan Gálvez, 9–11 avril) et le circuit urbain d'Adélaïde (12–14 novembre), qui reprend le GP d'Australie à Phillip Island.
Balaton Park (Hongrie) ne figure pas au calendrier 2027.
Le Qatar revient en début de saison (12–14 mars) après sa manche 2026 repoussée en novembre.
Portimão passe début octobre (1er–3 octobre), entre Aragon et la tournée asiatique.
2027.status_fr: Calendrier provisoire, sous réserve de validation par la FIM. Horaires à confirmer.

2027.summary: WorldSBK's provisional 2027 calendar has 12 rounds across nine countries, from Phillip Island on 19–21 February to a first-ever round in China, at Shanghai, on 29–31 October.
changes: Shanghai International Circuit joins the calendar and hosts the season finale.
Valencia (Circuit Ricardo Tormo) returns for the first time since 2010.
Jerez and Balaton Park are not on the 2027 calendar.
It is the last WorldSBK visit to Phillip Island: the Australian round moves to The Bend in 2028.
2027.status: Provisional calendar, subject to FIM approval. Session times are TBC.

2027.summary: The 2027 NASCAR Cup Series has 36 points races plus the All-Star Race, from the Daytona 500 on 21 February to the Championship race at Homestead-Miami on 14 November.
changes: The 26-race regular season ends at Darlington on 5 September; the 10-race playoffs open at Richmond on 11 September.
Watkins Glen and New Hampshire move into the playoffs; Homestead-Miami hosts the championship finale.
Naval Base Coronado in San Diego hosts a street race on 1 August, and Texas Motor Speedway returns on 2 May.
2027.status: Dates are confirmed. Race times are published closer to each event.

2027.summary: The 2027 World Rally Championship has 15 rounds on five continents, one more than 2026. It opens with the Rallye Monte-Carlo on 21–24 January and ends in Saudi Arabia on 25–28 November.
changes: Rally US (26–29 August) brings the WRC back to the United States for the first time since 1988, with gravel stages in Tennessee and Kentucky.
Rally Scotland (30 September – 3 October), based in Aberdeen, is the first British round since Wales Rally GB.
Rally d'Italia moves from Sardinia to Rome and switches from gravel to tarmac, in a July slot (8–11 July).
Rally de Portugal is not on the calendar.
Paraguay moves from August to October and Chile from September to November.
2027.status: Dates are confirmed. Itineraries and stage times are published closer to each rally; the Rally US service park is still to be confirmed.

2027.summary: The 2027 NTT INDYCAR SERIES has 17 races across 16 race weekends, from St. Petersburg on 7 March to Laguna Seca on 5 September.
changes: Barcelona joins the calendar on 18 July. Nashville, on the 2026 calendar, is not on the 2027 list.
Milwaukee stays a doubleheader (28–29 August), while Road America (27 June) and Mid-Ohio (4 July) are single races.
The Indianapolis 500 is on 30 May, after the Indy road course race on 15 May.
2027.status: Dates are confirmed. Session times are published closer to each weekend, so every race shows TBC until then.

2027.summary: The 2027 DTM has 16 races on eight race weekends in three countries, from the Red Bull Ring on 23–25 April to the Hockenheimring on 8–10 October.
changes: Oschersleben (7–9 May) and Zandvoort (6–8 August) swap places: Oschersleben is now the second weekend and Zandvoort the fifth, hosting races nine and ten.
The Red Bull Ring opens the season and the Hockenheimring closes it, as in 2026.
2027.status: Dates are published by the DTM. Session times are published closer to each event, so every race shows TBC until then.

2027.summary: British GT has eight races on six weekends in 2027, from Snetterton on 10–11 April to Donington Park on 16–17 October.
changes: Snetterton opens the season for the first time in the championship's 35-year history; Silverstone moves to 7–8 August.
Brands Hatch and Donington Park swap: Brands Hatch is now the penultimate round and Donington Park the decider.
Spa (19–20 June) is the only round outside the UK and the first endurance race of the year.
2027.status: Dates are provisional (revised in July 2026). Session times are published closer to each event, so every race shows TBC until then.

2027.summary: GT World Challenge America has seven race weekends in 2027, from Sonoma on 2–4 April to Indianapolis on 1–3 October.
changes: The Texas 8 Hour at Circuit of The Americas (7–9 May) replaces the Indianapolis 8 Hour as the series' longest race and is also an Intercontinental GT Challenge round.
Watkins Glen returns after five years away (21–23 May); Sebring is not on the 2027 list.
Indianapolis Motor Speedway hosts the finale as a regular three-hour round.
2027.status: Dates are provisional. Session times are published closer to each event, so every race shows TBC until then.

2027.summary: The 2027 Intercontinental GT Challenge has five rounds on four continents, from the Bathurst 12 Hour in February to the Suzuka 1000km in September.
changes: The new Texas 8 Hour at Circuit of The Americas (7–8 May) replaces the Indianapolis 8 Hour.
Suzuka 1000km becomes the season finale (3–5 September) and runs together with Super GT.
Bathurst (11–14 February) is still subject to agreement.
2027.status: Dates come from the series' June 2026 announcement. Session times are published closer to each event, so every race shows TBC until then.

2027.summary: The Michelin 24H SERIES European Series has five rounds in 2027: four 12-hour races from March to June, then the Barcelona 24H on 10–12 September.
changes: The Red Bull Ring (14–16 May) joins the calendar, the series' first visit to Austria since 2017.
The Nürburgring 12H, on the 2026 calendar, is not on the 2027 list.
2027.status: Dates are provisional and subject to final approval. Session times are published closer to each event, so every race shows TBC until then.

2027.summary: The NLS has eight races on seven weekends in 2027, its 50th anniversary season, from 20 March to 9 October.
changes: Round 4 on 7 August is the 6-hour race, and rounds 5 and 6 run as a double-header on 11–12 September.
2027 is also the 100th anniversary of the Nürburgring.
2027.status: Dates are provisional. Race names and session times have not been published yet, so the rounds are listed by number and every race shows TBC.
